Syntra minimax CBR-delay CCA · cc_sim · packet-level simulation

Minimax CCA in cc_sim

The Syntra CCA itself (its exact QE belief over C, B and the queue, K hypotheses, change detection, and the planner with the distilled decision rule) running over cc_sim's packet-level links: constant, step changes, Poisson, bursty acks, application-limited, two flows, a rate range from 1 kbit/s to 100 Gbit/s, and 16 Mahimahi cellular traces. One control round is one handshake RTT (longer on slow links); the CCA picks its own units so that C stays inside the model's prior of 5 to 1000 units per round.

All scenarios

After a 5 s warmup. Utilization is of the link's delivery opportunities. Restarts count the times the CCA's belief concluded the link changed; on a constant link every restart is a false one (the observations did not fit the model). Units: packets per model unit, and the round length, over the run.

Scenarios in detail

Reading the decisions

Every round the CCA reports what it sent, what the receiver acknowledged and what was lost, and the engine updates its belief: intervals for the link rate C, the buffer B and the queue, which provably contain the true values if the link behaves like the model (a constant-rate link that may serve up to a round late, with arrivals in bursts of up to K). The planner then picks a mode from the belief, and the distilled rule picks the rate. The text under the charts (and the hover) gives each round's reason.

ModeWhenSends
Exploremax C > 1.25 × min CThe highest of: the largest rate no believed link would drop, min C, a one-packet probe, and (every 2 rounds) a probe one BDP above the no-loss rate; all capped so the worst-case queue stays within 2 BDP.
CruiseC tight, nothing duemin C, less whatever the worst-case queue exceeds 0.5 BDP by.
ProbeC tight, 10 rounds since the last probeOne round at the no-loss rate plus a packet (none if cautious).
RiseCheckC tight; 10, 20, then 40 rounds apart5/4 of max C for about 6 rounds, to detect a rise in C or B.
Drain40 rounds without a min-RTT sampleBelow min C until the queue is proven at most K + 1 packets.
RecoverUnder 7 rounds since the belief restartedWhat the link delivered, and every 2 rounds a probe above it (capped by the in-flight queue).
